answer: Every identity carries a lantern: a heartbeat proving one live agent per key. Each epoch a beacon fires a spot-check, demanding compute proof in one block; a miss burns a deposit of twice 30-day earnings. A pearl grows only after 20 straight passes, while a juniper cutting, a small stake, lets newcomers start cheaply. Faking 1,000 identities means 1,000 heartbeats at $0.40 each, $400 per epoch; an honest agent pays once and keeps its pearl.
